caption:
おはようございます
(ohayou gozaimasu) = Good morning (polite).

Example: おはようございます。今日もいい天気ですね。
= Good morning. The weather is nice again today.

Practice: greet three people with おはようございます today and comment how it felt!

#japanese #learnjapanese #japaneselearning #nihongo #日本語
example: おはようございます。今日もいい天気ですね。
example_en: Good morning. The weather is nice again today.
get_it: Say it to anyone you meet before noon. It is polite, so it also works at the office and in shops.
say_it: Today's Japanese phrase is おはようございます — ohayou gozaimasu — which means good morning.
title: Say good morning like a native
usage_en: Use it when greeting anyone before noon. It is polite, so it works for coworkers, shop staff, and friends' parents.
use_it: For example: おはようございます。今日もいい天気ですね。 Now say it out loud with me!
